title: Task / Activity
description: One step inside a process (Core Model §02). The unit an agent is actually bound to and the unit get_task_context() returns (§03, §07). data_scope here is the least-privilege boundary the guardrail enforces. LOCKED for Phase 1.

id.description: Fully-qualified task id, e.g. CO.3.2.7.t3 — process apqc_code + '.t' + step. Globally unique, self-locating.

inputs.description: Data refs consumed. Flat ids in the agent package.

data_scope.description: The exact fields/records any actor on this task may touch — least privilege. The guardrail's data_scope defaults to this.

performed_by.description: Who may perform this task — a human role, an agent binding, or (the common case) both, with the guardrail deciding per-action which is allowed.

guardrail_ref.description: Task-level override. null = inherit the owning process's guardrail_ref (§02: inherit down unless overridden explicitly).
